title: Bodiliness and grabbiness separate perception from thought

statements.text: Bodiliness and grabbiness are what distinguish perceptual from nonperceptual awareness of a thing, and they are defined in functional terms, which the authors take to give a functional basis for the sensory character of experience.

sources.quote: This is what the difference between perceptual awareness and nonperceptual awareness (or thought) comes down to.
bodiliness and grabbiness are concepts defined strictly in functional terms
